description: This source file provides various hardware abstraction functions and APIs for Ethernet PHY (Physical Layer) management, such as delays, register read/write operations, and power control functions for Realtek PHY devices.

methods.name: void rtk_phylib_mdelay(uint32 msec)
methods.description: Delays execution for specified milliseconds, using different methods depending on the environment (Linux or other).

methods.name: void rtk_phylib_udelay(uint32 usec)
methods.description: Delays execution for specified microseconds, with special handling when running in Linux context.

methods.name: int32 rtk_phylib_mmd_write(rtk_phydev * phydev,uint32 mmd,uint32 reg,uint8 msb,uint8 lsb,uint32 data)
methods.description: Writes data to a specified MMD register of a PHY device, handling different environments.

methods.name: int32 rtk_phylib_mmd_read(rtk_phydev * phydev,uint32 mmd,uint32 reg,uint8 msb,uint8 lsb,uint32 * pData)
methods.description: Reads data from a specified MMD register of a PHY device, supporting Linux and non-Linux environments.

methods.name: int32 rtk_phylib_c45_power_normal(rtk_phydev * phydev)
methods.description: Sets the PHY device to normal power mode via MMD register.

methods.name: int32 rtk_phylib_c45_power_low(rtk_phydev * phydev)
methods.description: Sets the PHY device to low power mode via MMD register.

methods.name: int32 rtk_phylib_c45_pcs_loopback(rtk_phydev * phydev,uint32 enable)
methods.description: Enables or disables PCS loopback mode on the PHY device.
